note: Types inferred from the values a live router returned, for fields the console would not describe: a read-only property of a rowless menu has no cursor position for /console/inspect to answer about. This is weaker evidence than hack/typedump's and is marked observed rather than probed in the IR. Each verdict carries its sample. A field the router did not return, or returned empty, yields no verdict at all.
